name: 30540 · Ellijay, GA
findings: ZIP 30540 (Ellijay) has 51 nonprofit organizations. 25 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 19 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (57% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 30540 (Ellijay) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
72% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 6 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 57% of all organizations here have no identified type.
